primitives.name: Crawl Rate Limit
primitives.verbatim_quote: /Activity-Feed/userId/ # Do not index user profiles Crawl-delay: 5 User-agent: Slurp Disallow: /*/ctl/ # Slurp permits
primitives.assumptions: Fixed time interval between successive crawls per agent.

The crawler delay constraint introduces a temporal dimension that constrains state transitions within this space. The sitemap directive provides a global navigation anchor point. These elements combine into a dual structure: one governing spatial exclusions and another governing temporal access patterns. Failure modes include unauthorized access violating forbidden paths, or exceeding crawl delays leading to rate-limiting. The system exhibits a duality between static exclusion rules and dynamic timing constraints, forming a hybrid automaton with discrete and continuous components. This dual nature allows GSE to model crawler behavior as a constrained Markov process while GSI applies Bayesian inference over these constraints to reconstruct site topology.
